request.style: English, gentle female solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, warm and solemn, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
David fled to Nob that day
The priest met him in fear
Why are you alone he asked
With no one else near

[Chorus]
I have no ordinary bread
Only holy loaves remain
Since the LORD took them away
Fresh warm bread takes their place

[Verse]
Give me five loaves if you have
Or whatever you can find
The men have kept from women
As always on my mind

[Chorus]
I have no ordinary bread
Only holy loaves remain
Since the LORD took them away
Fresh warm bread takes their place

[Bridge]
Doeg the Edomite stood there
Watching with Saul’s men
He saw the son of Jesse
And knew the priest again

[Outro]
You shall surely die Ahimelech
With your father’s whole house
Doeg turned to strike them down
Eighty-five in this course
